rows.label: Railjack Intrinsics rank 5
rows.note: any one class; Earth Proxima showdown

rows.label: Mastery Rank 17
rows.note: enforced when Eleanor sells the weapon

conditions: Only one adversary at a time: clear or convert any active Kuva Lich, Sister of Parvos, or Coda first.
MR 17 is checked at the Eleanor purchase, not at Coda spawn: the usual lich MR exemption does not apply here.
Four depleted mods of one type transmute into one fresh charged mod of that type.
The Antivirus Bounty is pinned to the top of the Central Mall board and pays the largest Hex standing of any bounty.
bonuses: Antivirus and Potency mods drop as public loot off any squadmate's stab, so pubbing tops you up even when your own Coda hasn't spawned.

rows.label: spawn via Exterminate, Hell-Scrub or Legacyte Harvest
rows.note: kill Techrot for a Mixtape, hack the terminal

rows.label: correct Antivirus mercy
rows.note: all 3 equipped mods tested at once; no penalty for a wrong guess

rows.label: 100% disinfection
rows.note: 2 Potency mods once the Antivirus is known; missions alone cap at 95%

conditions: Duets spawn at 25% per mission, +25% per miss, guaranteed on the 4th.
A Duet that stumbles 3 times unstabbed, or a downed squad, flees the encounter.
Phases 1 and 3 are hazard-dodging with Transference disabled; phases 2 and 4 are the real fight, and the frontman regenerates until his backup band is dead.
Bring overguard or invulnerability (Revenant's Mesmer Skin, Nyx's Assimilate, Dante); the Coda's Toxin bypasses shield gating.
bonuses: Abort right after a correct-Antivirus stab; the disinfection banks immediately.
Squadmates who each defeat their own Coda in the same Concert add +1 Heartcell, up to +3, whether they vanquish or convert.

disclosures.title: run it inside the Antivirus Bounty
disclosures.body: Duets spawn during bounties too, so one run stacks Hex standing, Antivirus mods and disinfection progress at once.

disclosures.title: solo is faster
disclosures.body: A solo Concert is 5-7 minutes; a full squad is 12-20+ because every player's Coda gets its own two-part fight, back to back.

groups.meta: Batch A, one copy per 4-day rotation
conditions: Torxica is Batch A, alongside Coda Hema, Sporothrix, Catabolyst, Pox, Mire and Motovore; Batch B carries no Torxica.
One purchase per weapon per rotation; rotations flip every 4 days at 0:00 UTC.
An empty weapon slot is required before Eleanor will sell to you.
bonuses: Torxica has rolled a natural 60% unusually often through 2026: worth watching a rotation or two rather than banking whatever roll is up first.

conditions: Fusion takes the higher of the two bonuses × 1.1, capped at 60%.
Fuse into the copy holding your Forma and Catalyst; the donor's investments are destroyed.
Elemental Vice needs the weapon at rank 40 (5 Forma): 50,000 Hex standing at Rank 5, or 20 platinum, or a Temporal Archimedea/Nightwave drop.
